does_not_close: No coating-efficacy, product-performance, batch-release, or corrosion-rank authority.

Does not dispute the physical theory (Ridge regression, Hoerl & Kennard 1970) or the LOSD-CV split design; it disputes (a) whether the specific pinned Ridge MAE is independently reproducible from what is actually preserved in the repo, and (b) whether the beats-null effect is robust at the fold (independent-study) level LOSD-CV exists to certify, using an honest re-implementation of the KPI's own methodology.

Does not modify or supersede the signed NIST baseline KPI or its dataset; both remain independently valid artifacts, referenced by path + sha256. This audit's own independently-reproduced Ridge fit is DIFFERENT from (numerically stronger than) the signed fit, which is itself evidence the signed number is implementation-fragile.

Phase-1 would need the generating script committed to the module tree (not left in ephemeral scratch), per-fold (not only pooled) significance reporting, and ideally n_records >= 1000 with nonlinear ML (already flagged as awaiting in the target KPI).
headline: Independent reproducibility + fold-level significance audit of the NIST CORR-DATA marine steel baseline KPI's flagship '+0.0475 log10 (7.0%) Ridge-beats-NULL' claim. (T1) Re-derived from the raw published CSV alone (hash-pinned 9b6b82d0..., not the cached fixture): the filtered population reproduces EXACTLY (n=588 records / 30 source documents / 3 environments / 5 material groups). (T2) But the signed Ridge MAE does NOT reproduce: the generating script ('/tmp/corr_baseline.py' per receipt_meta) was never committed to the repo and no longer exists anywhere on this host; an honest re-implementation of the KPI's OWN stated methodology (identical features, [588,11] shape, alpha grid, LOSD-CV, seed=0) on the identical raw data gives MAE=0.5888 vs the signed 0.6331 (delta 0.0443) -- while the fitting-free NULL reproduces closely (0.6736 vs signed 0.6806, delta 0.0070). The specific pinned number is not independently auditable. (T3-T5) Using this audit's own (numerically STRONGER) reproduced Ridge fit, the beats-null effect is still NOT robust at the level LOSD-CV was built to certify -- one independent source-document study = one fold: Ridge beats NULL on only 17/30 folds (56.7%, binomial p=0.585, not distinguishable from a coin flip); the cluster-bootstrap 95% CI of the mean per-fold improvement is [-0.0329, 0.4846] (CROSSES ZERO); Wilcoxon signed-rank on the 30 paired fold MAEs gives p=0.2710. (T6) The pooled, record-weighted improvement figure is dominated by fold-size heterogeneity (top-3 largest source documents alone carry 54.9% of all 588 records) -- exactly the per-study methodology-bias risk LOSD-CV exists to guard against, and the null baseline is not held to the same fold-isolation standard as Ridge. Conclusion: H0 (a fold-robust, independently-reproducible beats-null effect) is H0 REFUTED -- on two independent grounds, neither of which depends on the other.

T1_population_filter_reproduction.note: Independent re-derivation from raw CORR-DATA_Database.csv (hash-pinned 9b6b82d0..., matches dataset_fixture_sha256 in the signed KPI), not from any cached fixture. n=588/30 docs/3 envs/5 material groups reproduces exactly -- the filtering step is genuinely reproducible.

T2_ridge_fit_independent_auditability.note: The NULL baseline (global per-material-group median, no fitting choices) reproduces to within 0.0070 log10 units -- consistent with a faithful filter/target reproduction. The Ridge fit, by contrast, is off by 0.0443 log10 units under an honest re-implementation of the KPI's OWN stated methodology (same features, same [588,11] shape, same alpha grid, same LOSD-CV, same seed=0). The actual generating script (receipt_meta.sci_pipeline_module = 'python3 /tmp/corr_baseline.py') was run once in ephemeral scratch and never committed to the module tree; it no longer exists anywhere on this host. The specific pinned number (MAE=0.6331, improvement=+0.0475) is therefore NOT independently reproducible/auditable from what is actually preserved in the repository -- only the population and the (fitting-free) null are.
T2_ridge_fit_independent_auditability.refute_bar: signed Ridge MAE reproduces from the stated methodology + raw data to within 5e-3 log10 units

T3_fold_level_sign_test.refute_bar: majority (>=~60%) of independent source-document folds should favor Ridge

T4_cluster_bootstrap_fold_level_ci.refute_bar: 95% CI of mean per-fold (per-source-document) MAE improvement includes 0

T6_aggregation_heterogeneity_diagnostic.note: The signed KPI's headline 0.0475 log10 improvement is POOLED (record-weighted across all 588 held-out predictions), NOT the mean of the 30 independent fold-level improvements the LOSD-CV split was designed to certify. The two diverge whenever fold size is heterogeneous, i.e. exactly the per-study methodology-bias risk LOSD-CV exists to guard against.
